# seerr_radarr_tags (Data Source)

Fetch Radarr tags via /api/v3/tag.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "seerr_radarr_tags" "example" {
  api_key = "your-radarr-api-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Radarr API key.

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base path when Radarr is served under a subpath.
- `hostname` (String) Radarr hostname when url is not provided.
- `port` (Number) Radarr port when url is not provided.
- `url` (String) Full Radarr URL. If set, it takes precedence over hostname, port, use_ssl, and base_url.
- `use_ssl` (Boolean) Use HTTPS when url is not provided.

### Read-Only

- `tags` (Attributes List) List of tags from Radarr. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Tag ID.
- `label` (String) Tag label.
